family: Ponte sobre Córrego São Domingos (ES-010, Conceição da Barra-ES) — longarina I pré-moldada protendida
source_status: project-specific design (PROJETO DE ENGENHARIA 2016, ES-010 bridge) as reproduced in a 2023 peer-reviewed book chapter; not a standard

source.authors: Rodrigo José Costa Nóbrega; Emmanoel Guasti Ferreira (Instituto Federal do Espírito Santo)
source.title: Análise comparativa das normas NBR 6118/2014, NBR 7188/2013 e AASHTO LRFD 2012, baseada na teoria da confiabilidade – estudo de caso de uma viga I da ponte sobre Córrego São Domingos na rodovia estadual ES-010, trecho Itaúnas - ES-421
source.book: Engenharias: pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação 2 (CIP record; running page footers read '... inovação 3'), org. Amanda Fernandes Pereira da Silva, Ponta Grossa-PR: Atena Editora, 2023, ISBN 978-65-258-0935-9, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
source.url_note: Book DOI above (Atena Editora); the book PDF was downloaded manually by the owner, exact file URL not recorded. The underlying IFES repository item (blocked by an anti-bot challenge in round 2) is https://repositorio.ifes.edu.br/bitstream/handle/123456789/2795/Template_ARTIGO_ABNT_Biblioteca_Rodrigo_revisado_final.pdf?isAllowed=y&sequence=1

residuals.area_from_self_weight: A = 0.374375 m2 -> 25 kN/m3 x A = 9.36 kN/m vs printed 9.4 (-0.4%, within 2-s.f. rounding). With the project's 2,50 tf/m3 and g = 9.81 the weight would be 9.18 kN/m (-2.3%), so the 9.4 figure implies a 25 kN/m3 convention.
residuals.yGc: NOT reproduced: gross composite centroid (b = 2.2 m, 18 cm slab, n = 1) is 1.031 m above the soffit; 0.921 m is not the precast-only centroid either (0.651 m). Its definition in the chapter is unclear; recorded, not used.

geometry_notes: Plain polygonal I, all dimensions printed on Figura 7: vertical chain 10 + 7,5 + 85 + 7,5 + 20 = 130 cm; widths 60 / 20 / 45 cm. Tapers run straight from the flange edges to the web; no chamfers drawn.

The 30 cm high rectangle drawn above the top flange and labelled 'ALÇA DE IÇAMENTO' (lifting loop) is excluded: it is not part of the girder concrete (hviga+laje = 1,48 m = 1,30 + 0,18 confirms a 130 cm girder).
Figure is a raster reproduction of the 2016 project drawing; dimensions read from the callouts, proportions checked against the drawing scale (~2.85 px/cm at 300 dpi).
